name: Grizzled Scalp
summary: In southern Darkshore, grizzled thistle bears roam the forests south of Auberdine. Their thick, furred hides reach Wizbang Cranktoggle, a gnome tinkerer with a use for them.

sections.title: A Peculiar Fermentation
sections.body: Grizzled thistle bears roam the road south of Auberdine, their rough pelts prized by hunters. Bring four scalps to Buzzbox 525, and the reason becomes clear. The bears’ fur is not meant for repairs or study. Wizbang Cranktoggle uses the hidden buzzboxes scattered across Darkshore as stills. Night elves frown on illicit brewing in their settlements, so Wizbang depends on adventurers to gather bear scalps and other strange ingredients for his beloved thistle bear beer.

faq.q: Where can I find Grizzled Scalps?
faq.answer: You can find grizzled thistle bears and their matriarch, the Den Mother, in the forests south of Auberdine, along Darkshore’s main trail.

faq.q: What are Grizzled Scalps used for?
aliases: what do i do with grizzled scalps
faq.answer: Deposit the scalps in Buzzbox 525, a mechanical terminal hidden in the bushes beside the road far south of Auberdine.

faq.q: Why does Buzzbox 525 need bear scalps?
faq.answer: Wizbang Cranktoggle uses his hidden buzzbox network to distill liquor away from night elf eyes. The scalps are an ingredient in his thistle bear beer.

faq.q: Why is Wizbang hiding his brewing in Darkshore's wilderness?
faq.answer: Wizbang hides his stills in the wilderness brush because the night elves of Auberdine object to unauthorized, noisy brewing in their sacred groves. The hidden contraptions let his moonshine operation go undetected.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see how gnomish skill disguises automated brewing stills as field-repair communication arrays.
As a night elf, you protect Darkshore’s wildlife and look askance at wanton poaching and gnomish stills hidden in the wilderness.
